Why Schoolview makes sense for
 Indiana

 Wes Bruce Indiana DOE
 wbruce@doe.in.gov

Indiana Introduced SGPs in 2009
• Second/third state to adopt
• Once the decision was made the deadline
 became yesterday
• Display was built in-house
• Used existing tools and displays that Indiana
 already had available
• Very serious flattery of Colorado
 – I mean really really flattering!

Indiana’s Motivation
• Support is all in house
• Quick design and build means little flexibility
• Functional by not elegant design
• Any change must compete for scarce resources
• Many changes requested – few implemented
• No stats is an Island (not even Indiana!)

Why Collaborate
• Take advantage of the best display
 – A display that is customizable
 – Allows you to turn on and off features
 – Provides amazing level of control and depth
• Take advantage of what others have learned
 – Different uses and needs in other states produce
 displays never thought of in Indiana but
 immediately useful
• Able to evolve!
